config.label: API key from spoken
config.description: API key from spoken.md (starts with pt_). Defaults to pt_demo (search works fully; transcripts limited to the demo episode).

config.label: Bearer followed by an API key from spoken
config.description: Bearer followed by an API key from spoken.md (Bearer pt_...). Optional: without it only the free tools work, and a client that supports OAuth is asked to sign in.
